answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond in the protocol kernel before voting, and the registration cost scales with the number of identities claiming one knoll of reputation. An attacker minting a thousand sock puppets must post a thousand bonds, each slashed on collusion proof, so forgery costs far exceed any reward. A sonnet-length audit trail of every stake and slash keeps peers verifiable, making mass identity cheap only for legitimate participants. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
